title: smtp: global Sieve evaluation, accept all local RCPT TO
description:
## Why
sieve_delivery currently loops over each RCPT TO, matches against config.users, and evaluates a per-user Sieve script for each match. Single-user mode: evaluate one global script once per message, deliver to the shared inbox regardless of envelope recipient.

## What

### sieve_delivery rewrite
Remove the per-recipient loop entirely. New logic:
1. Load and evaluate the global script (keyed to '_global' in the sieve scripts table, or the first/only script if only one exists). If no script is stored, default to Keep.
2. Apply reject-before-deliver: if any action is Reject, return SieveOutcome::Rejected immediately.
3. Apply Keep/FileInto/Discard actions once, writing to shared mailbox.

Keep action: INSERT INTO messages (mailbox_id, ...) using the INBOX mailbox_id from the mailboxes table (SELECT mailbox_id FROM mailboxes WHERE role='inbox').
FileInto('newsgroup:comp.foo'): unchanged — enqueue to NNTP.
FileInto(folder): INSERT INTO messages with mailbox_id looked up by role or name from mailboxes table.
Discard: drop message.

No user_id in any INSERT.

### sieve_for_user → sieve_global
Rename/replace sieve_for_user with sieve_global(pool, raw_message, envelope_from, envelope_to, cache).
Loads script for username '_global'; evaluates and returns actions.

### config.rs
Remove UserConfig struct and config.users Vec<UserConfig> field entirely.
No impact on SMTP AUTH (AuthConfig is separate).

### RCPT TO acceptance
Verify that the SMTP session handler accepts any RCPT TO for local delivery (no 550 user-unknown at RCPT TO time). If it currently checks config.users at RCPT TO time, remove that check for local delivery.

## Acceptance criteria
- A message to any RCPT TO address is stored in the shared INBOX.
- Sieve evaluation runs exactly once per message, not per recipient.
- config.users removed from config.toml schema; server starts without a users stanza.
- All tests pass.
notes: DECISION: global Sieve script loaded from file path in config, not from the DB script store. Config key: delivery.sieve_script (optional path string). If absent or file not found, default to Keep. File is read once at startup and cached in memory; SIGHUP or server restart to reload. The per-user DB script store (sieve_scripts table in smtp.db) and the Sieve admin HTTP API (SieveAdminConfig, the 127.0.0.1:4190 listener, all /scripts/* routes, store::load_active_script, store::save_script, etc.) are removed entirely. SieveAdminConfig removed from Config. SieveCache removed (no longer needed — compiled script held in an Arc<CompiledScript> in DeliveryState or equivalent). Migration 0013 drops the sieve_scripts table from smtp.db.
